name: ai-pm-os
description: A product manager's AI workflow, packaged as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: proof-before-done
plugins.description: Hooks that block 'done' claims until an external write has been read back, plus a backtest and a self-correct skill.

plugins.name: operating-rules
plugins.description: Opt-in SessionStart hook that injects a compact version of the eight operating rules into every session.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: A skill that keeps one lean STATUS.md current so a cleared session resumes from a single file, with a read-back before the receipt.

plugins.name: knowledge-compounding
plugins.description: A skill that captures explanations from your sessions into a cross-linked, diagrammed markdown knowledge base via a background agent, with a read-back before it reports done.

plugins.name: product-workflows
plugins.description: Three skills: market-research (sourced, verified briefs), prd (grounded requirements with a clean shareable copy), and decision-ledger (log bets, review them, never invent an answer).
